Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can process it. Even if your opponent has a Digimon with more digivolution cards than this card, this card's [When Attacking] effect will still give all of your opponent's Security Digimon -6000 DP for the turn.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Attacking] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash any 4 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon.

[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has no Digimon with as many or more digivolution cards as this Digimon, it unsuspends. Then, all of your opponent's Security Digimon get -6000 DP for the turn.
